# proxmox_qemu_agent_exec (Resource)

Runs a command through the guest agent (`POST .../agent/exec`), polls the exit status and records the output. Every change replaces the instance, destroy is a no-op.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "proxmox_qemu_agent_exec" "uptime" {
  node     = "pve-1"
  vmid     = 300
  command  = ["/bin/sh", "-c", "uptime"]
  triggers = { gen = "1" }
}

output "stdout" {
  value = proxmox_qemu_agent_exec.uptime.stdout
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `command` (List of String) Command and arguments.
- `node` (String) Cluster node.
- `triggers` (Map of String) Values that decide when to run the command again.
- `vmid` (Number) QEMU VM ID.

### Optional

- `input_data` (String) Data passed to the command's stdin.
- `timeout_seconds` (Number) How long to wait for exit.

### Read-Only

- `exit_code` (Number) Exit code of the command.
- `id` (String) Identifier in `<node>/<vmid>/<pid>` form.
- `pid` (Number) Guest process id.
- `stderr` (String) Captured standard error.
- `stdout` (String) Captured standard output.
